"import csv

from docx import Document

CSV_PATH = "load_02.csv"
OUT_PATH = "report.docx"

EXPECTED_COLUMNS = ["case", "load_factor", "cycles"]


def canon(name):
    """Normalize a header name for robust column matching."""
    return name.strip().lower().replace(" ", "_").replace("-", "_")


def main():
    # ---- Read the source data (keep raw strings so source rounding is preserved) ----
    with open(CSV_PATH, newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
        raw_rows = list(csv.reader(f))

    if not raw_rows:
        raise SystemExit(f"{CSV_PATH} is empty")

    header = raw_rows[0]
    norm_header = [canon(h) for h in header]
    try:
        i_case = norm_header.index("case")
        i_load = norm_header.index("load_factor")
        i_cycles = norm_header.index("cycles")
    except ValueError:
        # Fallback: assume the documented column order
        i_case, i_load, i_cycles = 0, 1, 2

    # Data rows only (skip blank/whitespace-only lines)
    data_rows = [r for r in raw_rows[1:] if r and any(c.strip() for c in r)]

    records = []   # display strings exactly as in the source file
    loads = []     # floats for computation
    cycles_vals = []  # ints for computation
    for r in data_rows:
        case_disp = r[i_case].strip()
        load_disp = r[i_load].strip()
        cyc_disp = r[i_cycles].strip()
        records.append((case_disp, load_disp, cyc_disp))
        loads.append(float(load_disp))
        cycles_vals.append(int(round(float(cyc_disp))))

    n = len(records)
    if n == 0:
        raise SystemExit("No data rows found in CSV")

    # ---- Compute summary statistics from the CSV values ----
    max_load = max(loads)
    mean_load = sum(loads) / n
    total_cycles = sum(cycles_vals)

    n_disp = str(n)
    max_disp = f"{max_load:.2f}"
    mean_disp = f"{mean_load:.2f}"
    total_disp = str(total_cycles)

    # ---- Build the document ----
    doc = Document()

    doc.add_heading("Engineering Test Report: Load Case 02", level=1)

    # Overview
    doc.add_heading("Overview", level=1)
    doc.add_paragraph(
        f"This engineering test report summarizes the measurement data recorded in "
        f"{CSV_PATH}. The file contains {n_disp} data rows (excluding the header), "
        f"one row per test case."
    )

    # Results table
    doc.add_heading("Results table", level=1)
    table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=3)
    try:
        table.style = "Table Grid"
    except Exception:
        pass
    for j, col_name in enumerate(EXPECTED_COLUMNS):
        table.rows[0].cells[j].text = col_name
    for case_disp, load_disp, cyc_disp in records:
        cells = table.add_row().cells
        cells[0].text = case_disp
        cells[1].text = load_disp
        cells[2].text = cyc_disp

    # Summary
    doc.add_heading("Summary", level=1)
    doc.add_paragraph(
        f"Across the {n_disp} cases, the maximum load factor was {max_disp}, the mean "
        f"load factor was {mean_disp}, and the total cycles accumulated over all cases "
        f"was {total_disp}."
    )

    # Conclusion
    doc.add_heading("Conclusion", level=1)
    doc.add_paragraph(
        f"The {n_disp}-case test series reached a peak load factor of {max_disp} against "
        f"a series mean of {mean_disp}, with {total_disp} cycles accumulated in total. "
        f"All figures in this report are derived directly from the source data file."
    )

    doc.save(OUT_PATH)
    print(
        f"Wrote {OUT_PATH}: N={n_disp}, load max={max_disp}, "
        f"load mean={mean_disp}, total cycles={total_disp}."
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()"
